opening.argument: The title identifies a live discussion about Shri Ram and the Constitution, while the broadcast presents a substantial panel: “A very big panel is with me. With me is Sambit Patra, the national reporter of BJP. With me is Vinod Kumar Bansal from VHP.” The speakers debate whether public authorities should promote or impose religious beliefs, including the question that “They should not promote any belief Nor should they superimpose anyone.” The split-screen Zee News layout further supports a televised panel format, and the discussion concerns the Constitution, secularism, religious sites, and the Ram Mandir rather than a commercial or financial offer. The material therefore establishes news and commentary coverage, while the disputed historical and legal issues remain matters debated by the guests.

citations.quote: Taal Thok Ke Live: Conspiracy with Shri Ram in the name of the Constitution?
A very big panel is with me. With me is Sambit Patra, the national reporter of BJP. With me is Vinod Kumar Bansal from VHP.
They should not promote any belief Nor should they superimpose anyone
